function calendarKeyboardActions() {\n        var actions = []\n        var groups = calendarKeyboardGroups()\n        for (var group = 0; group < groups.length; ++group)\n            for (var item = function moveCalendarVertical(step) {\n        var groups = calendarKeyboardGroups()\n        var position = calendarKeyboardPosition(groups)\n        if (position.group < 0) {\n
